gateways.title: Gateways
gateways.emptyHint: A gateway publishes services on a private host through a public host, over WireGuard.
gateways.intro: A gateway links a private host to a public host over WireGuard. Public ports on the public host are sent to services behind the private host.
gateways.name: Name
gateways.privateHostHint: The host with the services. It does not need a public address.
gateways.publicHostHint: The host with a public address, such as a cloud server.
gateways.endpointHint: The address the private host uses to reach the public host. Use its public IP or domain, not a Tailscale address.
gateways.sudoHint: Give the login passwordless sudo, or use a root login, then check again.
gateways.deleteHint: The tunnel and its rules are taken off both hosts.
gateways.noPorts: No ports yet. Add one, or turn on the port scan below.
gateways.targetHostPlaceholder: Empty for the private host itself
gateways.label: Label
gateways.portBusyHint: Forwarding it would hide that service from the internet.
gateways.scanDesc: Look for services listening on the private host and list them here, each with its own switch.
gateways.autoEnableDesc: Forward new ports right away. Off means you switch each one on.
gateways.firewallTitle: Open these in your cloud firewall
gateways.firewallHint: Termix cannot change a cloud firewall such as an AWS security group. Allow these ports on the public host.
gateways.scanGuestsDesc: On a Proxmox host, also look inside running VMs and containers. VMs need the guest agent.
